messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> page fired: HIGH on inference-serve (route-surge-detector). PD#582911. alert: route_latency_p99 > 1s for 3m. auto-escalate enabled
oncall-jay: acked. jumping in. pinging @sara and @mike for quick triage
sara: looking — small spike in router queue depth, batcher threshold bumped. p50 ~ 70ms, p99 ~ 1.3s across one AZ
mike: checking autoscaler logs — no recent scale events and no OOMs. infra looks steady.
kate: any sign of customer errors or 5xx? need impact check
oncall-jay: running a quick healthcheck and traffic tail: ```curl -sS http://router-prod.internal/health && curl -sS http://router-prod.internal/metrics | grep route_latency```
ops-bot: health: OK; metrics sample: route_latency_p50=68ms; route_latency_p95=210ms; route_latency_p99=1.28s; inflight=42
sara: logs show KV-cache prefill activity spike around +2m before alert, but KV error rate 0. small transient stalls in prefix lookup. no obvious model OOMs
oncall-jay: throttles? batch size autocfg bumped to 128 for short window — probably caused queueing. rolling that back now: `kubectl set env deploy/batcher BATCH_MAX=64`
mike: rollback applied, observing drop in queue depth. p99 trending down to ~350ms
incident-bot: Alert auto-resolved (pager closed) — route_latency_p99 below threshold for 2m
oncall-jay: marking as resolved in thread. no customer-facing errors observed. no rollback to prod required beyond the batcher env tweak. filing follow-up ticket for batching policy tuning :memo:
sara: will open ticket (ENG-7642) to add smoother decay for BATCH_MAX and tie to KV prefill signals
kate: thanks team. add postmortem note if recurrence. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: automated note: PD#582911 auto-resolved after 7m, incident severity: transient, customer impact: none detected. Follow-up: batching policy + KV-prefill metric link: https://grafana.internal/r/abc123
oncall-jay: closing out here — will monitor for 24h and tag oncall handoff if anything reappears
sara: ack.
